remarks: Why rent when you can own? This affordable 1-bedroom condo is just waiting for your finishing touches! - This second floor unit offers tons of natural light, generous closet space, and a spacious kitchen with washer/dryer in-unit! - Heat and Hot Water included in common charges! - The location is hard to beat too; walkable to downtown Wall St, close to I-95, the Route 7 connector, and Route 1, plus just minutes from the SoNo train station for an easy commute! One reserved off/street parking space + plenty of visitor parking! Private storage unit and common laundry room in basement. Schedule your appointment today, this one won't last long!
